summary: The words a record may say how far what it taught holds, published so a host and the party that published its framework mean the same thing by one of them. Two words and no verdict spoken in either: which word a record carries is the host's statement about its own work, and this kit ships neither a default nor a mark of its own.

extents.means: What was learned is true of this repository and the circumstances it is in -- its stack, its people, its history. It is addressed to nobody else. A record says so rather than leaving it to silence, because a lesson nobody marked and a lesson deliberately kept at home look identical from outside.

What was learned is true of any repository run this way, not only of this one. A record marked so is making a claim about the framework rather than about its host -- which is the only kind of claim a publisher can be asked to answer, and the only kind worth anyone's time to carry.
